entries.title: Tosa class — design reconstruction
entries.configuration: Modern historical-design reconstruction by Tzoli of the uncompleted Tosa battleship: five twin 410 mm turrets and one funnel. Both views preserve the source configuration. This is a modern reconstruction, not a period shipyard plan; small historical fittings are reference detail and do not change the game’s abstract equipment statistics.

review.notes: Inspected both views of the complete source. Hull endpoints, all five twin main turrets, bridge, funnels, masts and deck equipment align; forward/aft turret directions agree. Preserved the artist attribution and source license.
